question: Who among the following won the US Open 2021 men’s tennis singles final?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Daniil Medvedev.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daniil Medvedev**** defeated Novak Djokovic **in the final, 6–4, 6–4, 6–4 to win the men's singles tennis title at the 2021 US Open.
 
• It was his first major title and he only lost one set en route **(against Botic van de Zandschulp in the quarterfinals).**
 
• **Daniil Sergeyevich Medvedev** is a Russian professional tennis player.
 
• He is currently **ranked world No. 1 **by the Association of Tennis Professionals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Novak Djokovic** is a Serbian professional tennis player.​ 
 
• Novak Djokovic is currently ranked world No. 6 in singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals. 
 
• **Lewis Alan Hoad** was an Australian tennis player whose career ran from 1950 to 1973. 
 
• **John Herbert Crawford,** OBE was an Australian tennis player during the 1930s.
 
• John Herbert Crawford was the World No. 1 amateur for 1933, during which year he won the Australian Open, the French Open, and Wimbledon, and was runner-up at the U.S.
